Halve the pears and remove the cores.
Arrange in a baking dish and add cinnamon and water.
Bake until soft and serve with walnuts.
Vegetable egg muffins
50 g white cheese
Preheat the oven to 180 degrees and grease the muffin tins.
Chop the vegetables small and lightly squeeze the zucchini.
Mix the eggs, vegetables and crumbled cheese.
Divide among the tins and bake until the eggs are fully cooked.
Celeriac in olive oil
2 celeriac
Juice of 1 orange
Peel the celeriac, carrot and potato and cut into equal pieces.
Arrange the vegetables in a pot and add the olive oil.
Add the orange juice and enough water to cover the vegetables.
Cook over low heat until soft and serve lukewarm.
Baked köfte with vegetables
350 g minced meat
Grate the onion and knead with the mince, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shape small köfte from the mixture.
Slice the potato and carrot and toss with oil.
Place the köfte and vegetables on a tray and bake at 190°C for about 30 minutes until the köfte are fully cooked inside.
Cauliflower gratin
Separate the cauliflower into florets and boil until slightly soft.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake at 190°C until golden on top.
Chicken and vegetable noodles
250 g chicken breast
200 g noodles
2 tablespoons soy sauce
1 tablespoon vegetable oil
Boil the noodles according to the packet instructions.
Cut the chicken into thin strips and cook through in a pan.
Add the thinly sliced vegetables and sauté so they stay crisp.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, mix and serve hot.
Spinach and cheese börek
300 g spinach
Half a cup yogurt
Wash and chop the spinach and mix with the cheese.
Whisk the yogurt, egg and oil.
Brush the yufka with the sauce, roll up with the filling and arrange on the tray.
Bake at 190°C until golden on top and cooked inside.
Celeriac with orange
Peel the celeriac, carrot and potato and dice them.
Stir the vegetables in olive oil for a few minutes.
Add the orange juice and water.
Cook covered until the vegetables are soft.
Baked yogurt chicken
500 g chicken thighs
Mix the yogurt, oil, garlic and thyme.
Coat the chicken with the sauce and rest for at least 15 minutes.
Place the chicken in a baking dish.
Bake at 200°C until the chicken is fully cooked and reaches an internal temperature of 74°C.
Mushroom sauté
400 g button mushrooms
Soften the onion and pepper in oil.
Add the mushrooms and cook over high heat until they release and reabsorb their liquid.
Add thyme and serve hot.
Apple cinnamon cake
2 apples
Add the milk and oil; mix in the flour, baking powder and cinnamon.
Fold the diced apples into the batter and pour into the tin.
Bake at 175°C until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean.
Bulgur salad with chickpeas
Soak the bulgur in hot water until soft.
Chop the tomato, cucumber and parsley small.
Mix the cooked chickpeas with the bulgur and vegetables.
Add lemon and olive oil and serve.
Pasta with tomato and basil
Briefly stir the garlic in oil and add the chopped tomatoes.
Cook the sauce until the tomatoes are soft.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and chopped basil.
Baked vegetable mücver
Mix with the egg, flour, dill and oil.
Spread the mixture in a small dish lined with baking paper.
Bake at 190°C until fully cooked inside and golden on top.
Tahini walnut cookies
1 cup tahini
Half a cup powdered sugar
Half a cup ground walnuts
Mix the tahini and sugar.
Add the flour, walnuts and baking powder to make a soft dough.
Take small pieces of dough and arrange on a tray.
Bake at 175°C until the edges are lightly coloured, then let cool.
Roasted pepper salad with cheese
3 red peppers
A handful of parsley
Roast the peppers and peel off the skins.
Cut the peppers into strips.
Crumble the cheese and mix with the peppers.
Add lemon, oil and parsley and serve.
Baked sea bass with vegetables
Thinly slice the vegetables and toss with oil.
Spread the vegetables in a baking dish and place the fish on top.
Add lemon slices and thyme.
Bake at 190°C until the fish is opaque and flakes easily and the vegetables are cooked.
Chicken soup with egg-lemon-yogurt liaison
Cook the chicken through in water with the carrot and shred it.
Whisk the yogurt, egg yolk and flour.
Pour the liaison into the pot while stirring and simmer for a few minutes.
Roasted eggplant soup
Roast the eggplants and peel them.
Soften the onion in butter, add the flour and toast briefly.
Add the chopped eggplant and water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the milk, blend and reheat.
Zucchini with minced meat
1 tea glass water
Sauté the onion in oil, add the mince and cook until it has completely changed colour.
Chop the tomatoes and add them to the pot.
Cut the zucchini into half-moons and add them.
Add the water and cook covered until the zucchini are soft.
Baked chicken with kashar
100 g kashar cheese
Cut the chicken into cubes and sear the outside in oil.
Transfer to a baking dish with the chopped tomato and pepper.
Bake at 190°C until the chicken is fully cooked.
Sprinkle with kashar and return to the oven until melted.
Baked salmon and asparagus
200 g asparagus
Preheat the oven to 190°C.
Trim the asparagus and toss with oil and thyme.
Put the salmon on the tray with the vegetables and squeeze lemon over.
Bake for about 15-20 minutes until the salmon is fully cooked inside.
Zucchini mücver with cheese
Mix with the egg, crumbled cheese, flour and dill.
Drop spoonfuls into a lightly oiled pan.
Fry both sides over medium heat until cooked through.
Baked broccoli bites
80 g kashar cheese
Steam the broccoli until soft and chop finely.
Mix with the egg, breadcrumbs and cheese.
Shape small balls from the mixture.
Bake at 190°C until golden on top.
Chard with chickpeas
1 bunch chard
Wash the chard thoroughly and chop.
Put the chard and cooked chickpeas in the pot.
Add the water and cook until the chard is soft.
Buckwheat pilaf with vegetables
Chop the onion, carrot and zucchini small and sauté in oil.
Add the buckwheat and stir.
Add the water and cook covered until the grains are soft.
Cream-free mushroom pasta
Boil the pasta for the time on the packet and set aside a ladle of the cooking water.
Sauté the mushrooms in oil until their liquid evaporates.
Add the garlic and stir briefly.
Lower the heat, mix in the pasta, a little cooking water and the yogurt, and serve.
Spinach lasagne
8 lasagne sheets
200 g lor cheese
100 g kashar
Wash and chop the spinach and cook it in a pan until its liquid evaporates.
Make a béchamel sauce with butter, flour and milk.
Layer the lasagne, spinach, lor and sauce in a baking dish.
Sprinkle with kashar and bake at 180°C until the sheets are soft.
Chicken Caesar salad
1 small lettuce
1 dessert spoon mustard
Cook the chicken through in a pan and slice.
Cut the bread into cubes and toast in the oven.
